description.value: Parkside Resort Motel is listed in OSM as a motel on 11th Avenue East in Prince Rupert, BC, a key stop for cyclists touring the North Coast. The property's former website domain has been compromised and no longer serves motel content, making it impossible to confirm current operational details or amenities. Prince Rupert is a common endpoint for cyclists arriving via the BC Ferries route from the south or the Alaska Marine Highway from the north.
